summary: Pitraya's Pitru Paksha 2026 Special Package is designed for the most auspicious 16-day ancestral window of the year. This guide covers the complete package inclusions, pricing tiers, ceremony schedule, and why booking 3+ months ahead is critical.
content:
Pitru Paksha 2026 runs September 7–21. This is the most auspicious 16-day window of the year for Pind Daan — every day of Pitru Paksha corresponds to a specific ancestor's type (based on their death tithi), culminating in the supreme Mahalaya Amavasya on September 21.

### Why Pitru Paksha Requires Special Planning
Approximately 5-8 lakh pilgrims visit Gaya during Pitru Paksha. Hotels within 1 km of Vishnupad Temple book out by May-June. Gayawal Purohit ceremony slots fill rapidly. Airline tickets on the Gaya route see 40-80% price increases.

### Pitraya Pitru Paksha 2026 Package Tiers

**Tier 1 — Pitru Paksha Essential (₹22,000 per adult)**
- 1-day ceremony (3 Dhaams)
- AC hotel 1 night near Vishnupad
- Airport/station transfer (one-way)
- Complete samagri
- Vamsavali entry
- Ceremony certificate

**Tier 2 — Pitru Paksha Standard (₹45,000 per adult)**
- 2-day ceremony (16 Dhaams across 2 days)
- AC hotel 2 nights (near Vishnupad)
- Airport and station transfers (both ways)
- Brahmin Bhojan (3 Brahmins)
- All samagri
- Video documentation
- Vamsavali entry + digital certificate

**Tier 3 — Pitru Paksha Premium (₹85,000 per adult)**
- 3-day ceremony (all 45 Dhaams)
- Luxury hotel 3 nights (within 500m of Vishnupad)
- Private AC vehicle for 3 days
- Brahmin Bhojan (11 Brahmins)
- Senior hereditary Gayawal Purohit
- Complete HD ceremony video
- Mahalaya Amavasya ceremony included
- Priority Vishnupad Temple access

### Early Booking Benefits
Book before April 30, 2026:
- 10% discount on all packages
- Priority hotel selection (temple-facing rooms)
- Preferred ceremony timing slot

faqs.question: Can I choose which specific day of Pitru Paksha for my ceremony?
faqs.answer: Yes — ideally on the tithi matching your ancestor's death anniversary. Pitraya coordinates the ceremony timing based on your ancestor's death date. For Mahalaya Amavasya (September 21) specifically, slots are extremely limited and book months ahead.
